failure_policy: Preserve every planned dataset and unsuccessful fit. Failed or unattempted planned permutations remain unknown within B599; never condition the denominator on successful fits. Do not replace a source-run failure with a successful duplicate from another run.
execution_implementation: Use the HPC-validated direct normal-PDF objective with unchanged arithmetic/optimizer. This single-engine run recomputes nuisance for every new label permutation. No mixture reuse across schemes, datasets or permutations.
freeze_policy: Immutable source/config snapshot created before any42xxxxxx confirmation data are generated. Earlier41xxxxxx structural-preflight data are excluded. Changes prompted by confirmation outcomes require a new candidate and fresh seeds.
full_p_policy: Exactly the absolute seeds 42100000 through 42100009 complete every local B599 budget. This is a diagnostic subset, not the core's larger full-p100 sample. full_p_first_n stays zero under all chunking.
primary_endpoint: Complete-null FWER of the target-matched diagnosis-restricted three-pair Bonferroni family, and each local pair's error rate, with planned-sample unknown bounds and dataset-level Monte Carlo intervals.

family_definition.correction: Bonferroni across the three separate target-matched local p-values
family_definition.scope: All three matching schemes are stored in the same run and dataset row. Only each scheme's tested_pair_index enters the family. No global-max test is assembled from these distinct reference distributions.
family_definition.validity: Each true local null requires the two groups' biomarker/missingness input law to agree given Diagnosis. The third group's labels stay fixed while the complete fitting pipeline is rerun. This does not establish universal ordering-only strong FWER.

data_and_fit_reuse.current_runner_behavior: Regenerate the deterministic dataset and recompute one observed repaired fit per seed. Do not copy source fit_records.jsonl into a new output directory. Do not schedule the source diagnosis D-all scheme again.
data_and_fit_reuse.cheapest_safe_current_plan: Run only the new local schemes. Link completed source D-all and current local results at analysis time by cell, engine, seed and verified provenance. The small observed-fit recomputation cost is intentional.
requirements_before_any_future_import: A dedicated importer must explicitly validate resolved DesignConfig, generated data hash, biomarker order, engine and likelihood implementation, numerical dependency fingerprints and source provenance.

Source observed statuses, failures and timeout policy must be retained. Shared core paired-job timeouts differ from standalone repaired-job budgets; do not silently impute local failures from a source success.
Import only exact same-data observed statistical evidence. Never import an original-label nuisance fit as a fit of another permutation.
Source D-all statistics remain labeled with their own scheme and run; they are a comparison reference and never members of the new local family.
Record immutable source locations and content hashes and reject duplicate or inconsistent successful orderings/statistics.
